page.layout: One page of title text, centred; a woodcut vignette in the middle; below it the imprint; handwriting and a stamp at the lower right (not transcribed); a digitiser's watermark at the bottom right (not transcribed).

main_text.l: quam Romanus Pontifex sibi in Ecclesiam

page.notes: The woodcut vignette (a globe/wreath with leaves and rays) is not transcribed. Handwritten inscriptions ("S. Andrea", "della Valle") and an oval stamp, a crowned stamp and the digitiser's "Google" watermark are excluded. "Sive," is set in italic script; "sibi" and "suprema" long s rendered as plain s. The imprint line "GENEVAE," is in small capitals with "Apud PETRVM AVBERTVM." below it.
